English in Classes 1–5

An English group at the right level

ELGA stands for English Language and General Awareness. In Classes 1–5, children learn English in groups according to their current English level. A child in Class 2 and a child in Class 3 can be in the same group.

Veer Patta uses the LEAD programme up to Class 10.

Nursery & KG

Starting school

The activity room has low tables and small chairs. On a visit, families can see the room and discuss entry age and the first few days of school.

Nursery & KG admissions

Classes 1–5

Reading, language and numbers

Primary pupils work on reading, writing and number sense. In ELGA, children from Classes 1–5 learn English in groups matched to their current level.

How ELGA groups work↑

Classes 6–8

Middle school subjects

Children study a wider range of subjects in middle school. Families can discuss the timetable, languages and practical work with the school.

Classes 9–10

The secondary years

Pupils work towards the RBSE Class 10 board examination. Ask the school about the subjects and the assessment schedule for the current session.

Classes 11–12

Science, Commerce or Arts

After Class 10, pupils choose a stream. The office can confirm subject combinations and eligibility before a family makes its Class 11 decision.

Where should we start for a young child?

Start with Nursery or KG. The office can help decide the appropriate class and explain age eligibility.

What are the current fees?

Fees depend on the class. Ask the office for tuition and any separate costs for books, uniform or transport. You can request a written fee breakdown.

Contact the office
How do we visit the campus?

Find the school opposite Mela Ground in Amet. Call before travelling so the office can confirm a suitable time.

What can we choose in Class 11?

Science, Commerce and Arts are the school’s streams. Ask the office to confirm individual subjects, eligibility and availability.
